description: Read findings for a site (latest run by default, or one run by id) with server-side filters: status, severity, rule and page substring. Returns rule, page, status, detail, evidence key plus facet counts so the caller can see what else is in the run. Rule text is returned as authored. Requires the audit:read scope.

page.description: Only return findings whose page URL contains this substring

ruleId.description: Only return findings for this rule

runId.description: Audit run id; defaults to the latest run

severity.description: Only return findings frozen at this severity

status.description: Only return findings with this status

name: get_audit_findings
title: Read audit findings
